purpose: deliver approved artifacts to environments through an automated, auditable and repeatable pipeline
entry_criteria: Approval points and deployment strategy are agreed
procedure: Model deployment as a pipeline from the artifact digest to each environment in order.
Use the same deployment steps in every environment; vary only configuration.
Run automated checks after each deployment (health, smoke) and stop on failure.
Require human approval before production in the pipeline, with the approver recorded.
Use short-lived credentials for deployment and keep them out of logs.
Record who deployed what, when and with what result.
acceptance_criteria: The same digest moves through all environments
A failed check stops the pipeline
Credentials are short-lived and not logged

validation.command: gh run view --json conclusion,jobs   # example for the deployment run
validation.expect: all jobs succeeded; production job shows an approval

validation.check: compare the digest deployed to production with the artifact record

failure_modes.response: Make the approval mandatory in the pipeline

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The pipeline deploys digest sha256:9f2c to staging, runs smoke checks, waits for the production approver, then deploys the same digest to production and records the approver and times.
